description.narrative: Hamro Palo's mission is to empower adolescent girls, women and boys and equip them with the skills, and knowledge to create their own safe and healthy futures. The organization delivers culture sensitive services that advance adolescents health, safety, and confidence and leadership skills. This grant will support Hamro Palo's gender transformative workshops and support for adolescent girls, young women and boys to allow them to create their own safe and healthy futures. The Equality Fund grant will support Hamro Palo's core operational costs as well as advancing the following priorities: -Expand the flagship Her Turn program to reach more girls in rural villages, responding to requests to deliver workshops in more schools. -Partner with schools to expand girls-in-sports initiatives which showed great success in terms of girls interest and confidence they have built up during the pilot activity last year. -Support activities to create safe spaces and platforms advancing girls and women's rights as well as core operations costs, such as travel, administrative support, audit and monitoring and evaluation costs
